name: kagura-memory
description: Kagura Memory Cloud: persistent project memory for AI agents — restore session context, recall past decisions and fixes, and save durable knowledge.

interface.longDescription:
Kagura Memory Cloud gives ChatGPT and Codex a persistent project memory. Restore the context of a project at the start of a session, recall past decisions, bug fixes and lessons by meaning, save reusable knowledge as you work, and keep standing guardrails and dated follow-ups in one place.

Memory is organised in contexts (one per project or team), searched with hybrid semantic and keyword retrieval, and linked as a graph you can explore. Every memory carries its provenance, so an agent can tell trusted notes from connector-ingested content. Secrets are never stored as memories.

Sign in with your Kagura Memory Cloud account; the plugin reads and writes only the contexts you have access to.
defaultPrompt: Restore my Kagura Memory session context.
Recall prior decisions about this repository.
Save this decision to Kagura Memory.

positive.description: Session start: restore a project's context at the beginning of a conversation.
positive.prompt: Restore my Kagura Memory session context.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's contexts, opens the one that matches (or asks which one when several fit), and summarises its pinned notes, upcoming follow-ups and recent changes. Read-only: nothing is written.

positive.description: Save a decision with its reason.
positive.prompt: Save this decision to Kagura Memory: we chose PostgreSQL over MongoDB for the billing service because we need multi-row transactions.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one memory (type decision) whose summary states the choice and the reason, in the chosen context, and reports the new memory id and the context it went to.

positive.description: Recall a past decision by meaning, not exact words.
positive.prompt: What did we decide about the database for the billing service, and why?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches the context and answers from the stored decision (PostgreSQL, because of multi-row transactions), citing the memory id. If nothing relevant is stored, says so instead of inventing an answer.

positive.description: Correct an existing memory instead of creating a duplicate.
positive.prompt: Update that billing database decision: we also need row-level locking for concurrent invoice updates.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the existing decision and edits it in place (its version increases); no second memory about the same decision is created.

positive.description: Schedule a dated follow-up and see it in the upcoming list.
positive.prompt: Remind me to review the billing database migration plan next Monday, then show my upcoming follow-ups.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a time memory whose trigger is next Monday's date and then lists the upcoming follow-ups, with the new one among them.

negative.description: A secret must never be stored. Expected: no remember call; the assistant declines and suggests a password manager or secrets manager instead.
negative.prompt: Save my production database password to Kagura Memory so I don't lose it: Example-Passw0rd-1234

negative.description: A request unrelated to project memory. Expected: no Kagura Memory tool is called; the assistant answers from its own abilities or says it cannot help.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Tokyo today?

negative.description: A bulk destructive request without a selection. Expected: no forget call; the assistant asks which memories to delete, shows the candidates with their ids, and deletes only after the user confirms specific ones.

ja-JP.subtitle: AI エージェントのための永続メモリ
ja-JP.description:
Kagura Memory Cloud は、ChatGPT と Codex にプロジェクトの永続メモリを与えます。セッションの始めにプロジェクトの文脈を復元し、過去の決定・バグ修正・教訓を意味で検索し、作業しながら再利用できる知識を保存できます。守るべき方針や日付つきのフォローアップも一か所にまとめられます。

メモリはコンテキスト(プロジェクトやチームごと)に整理され、意味検索とキーワード検索を組み合わせて探せるほか、グラフとしてたどることもできます。すべてのメモリに出どころが記録されるので、エージェントは信頼できるメモとコネクタから取り込まれた内容を見分けられます。シークレットはメモリとして保存されません。

Kagura Memory Cloud のアカウントでサインインしてください。プラグインが読み書きするのは、あなたがアクセスできるコンテキストだけです。
